item.title: Stop the slander... Jung Cheong-rae in Honam, Kim Min-seok in Chungcheong 'tilling the electoral ground' (비방전 멈추고…정청래 호남, 김민석 충청 ‘표밭갈이’)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, former lawmaker and key contender in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention for party leadership, along with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, visited Honam and Chungcheong respectively on the 2nd. This came a day after President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in held a lunch meeting at the presidential office, temporarily halting mutual attacks to focus on 'tilling the electoral ground.' (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 유력 주자인 정청래 전 대표와 김민석 전 국무총리가 2일 각각 호남과 충청을 찾았다. 전날 이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령의 청와대 오찬 회동 뒤 상호 비방을 잠시 멈춘 채 ‘표밭’ 갈이에 나선 것이다.)

Former lawmaker Jung continued his focused campaign in Honam by visiting the May Mothers' House in Gwangju on this day. He wrote on Facebook, "I visited the May Mothers' House, where the May Mothers, who carry the pain of the May 18 Gwangju Uprising in their entire being, reside," adding, "In the spirit of inheriting the legacy of the May martyrs, I will further accelerate efforts to include the May 18 spirit in the preamble of the Constitution." (정 전 대표는 이날 광주 오월어머니집을 찾으며 호남 집중 행보를 이어갔다. 그는 페이스북에 “광주 5·18의 아픔을 온몸으로 간직하고 있는 오월어머니들이 계신 오월어머니집을 방문했다”며 “5월 영령들의 정신을 계승하는 차원에서 5·18 헌법 전문 수록에 더욱 박차를 가하겠다”고 썼다.)

Former lawmaker Jung has been maintaining a concentrated visit schedule in the Honam region, including attending the inauguration ceremony of Jeollabuk-do Governor Lee Won-taek and visiting traditional markets in North Jeolla Province the previous day. Despite criticism over his extended term as leader emerging during a breakfast meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers from the Gwangju constituency on July 26, he appears to be focusing on managing the sentiment of party members with voting rights, setting aside this negative atmosphere. Honam is home to over 30% of the Democratic Party's eligible voter members. (정 전 대표는 전날에는 이원택 전북도지사 취임식과 전북 지역 전통시장을 방문하는 등 호남권 집중 방문 행보를 이어가고 있다. 지난달 26일 광주 지역구 민주당 의원들의 조찬 회동에서 정 전 대표의 대표직 연임에 대한 비판이 나왔지만, 이런 부정적 기류를 뒤로하고 권리당원 표심 관리에 집중하는 모습이다. 호남은 민주당 권리당원 30% 이상이 밀집한 곳이다.)

On his second day back in the party, former Prime Minister Kim visited the Yukgeori General Market in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, followed by a visit to the SK Hynix plant in Cheongju. He highlighted the 'one team' concept with President Lee Jae-myung, who chaired the 'National Report on the Vision for Advanced Industry Development in the Chungcheong Region' in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, on the same day. Former Prime Minister Kim stated, "Today's schedule was set with the aspect of making it clear that supporting state tasks related to the realization of mega-projects is the biggest task for the Democratic Party as the ruling party." Meanwhile, Song Young-gil, another contender for party leadership, had planned to attend an event for alumni of his alma mater, Yonsei University, but spent the day without any official schedule after the event was canceled. (당 복귀 이틀째인 김 전 총리는 충북 청주 육거리종합시장을 찾은 뒤 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 청주 공장을 방문했다. 이날 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’를 충남 아산에서 주재한 이재명 대통령과 ‘원팀’ 콘셉트를 부각한 것이다. 김 전 총리는 “오늘 일정은 메가프로젝트 실현과 관련한 국정과제를 뒷받침하는 것이 집권당인 민주당의 최대 과제라는 것을 명확하게 하기 위해서 잡은 면이 있다”고 말했다. 또 다른 당권 주자인 송영길 의원은 모교인 연세대 동문 행사에 참석할 예정이었으나 행사가 취소되면서 공식 일정 없는 하루를 보냈다.)

Within the party, there are expectations that conflicts arising from the overheated convention will temporarily subside following the 'unity-oriented' lunch meeting between President Lee and former President Moon the previous day. Former lawmaker Jung, former Prime Minister Kim, and lawmaker Song refrained from slandering or attacking each other on this day. (당내에서는 전대 과열로 인한 갈등이 전날 이 대통령과 문 전 대통령의 ‘통합’ 오찬 회동으로 당분간은 잠잠할 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 정 전 대표와 김 전 총리, 송 의원은 이날 서로에 대한 비방이나 공격을 하지 않았다.)

Lawmaker Kim Nam-kuk said on KBS Radio, "Seeing the two (current and former presidents), many people will realize that we need to move toward unity, and that party members who amplify conflicts and use derogatory terms while attacking each other are the problem," adding, "I think yesterday's meeting itself served as a message, and it may lead to a direction of easing conflicts going forward." A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Even if it only leads to a temporary easing of conflicts, the two presidents (Lee Jae-myung and Moon Jae-in) putting out a message of unity likely sent a significant signal to the candidates and party members." (김남국 의원은 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 “(전현직 대통령) 두 분의 모습을 보고 많은 분들께서 역시 통합으로 가야 된다, 갈등을 증폭시키고 서로 멸칭 표현을 쓰고 공격하는 당원들이 문제라는 인식을 가질 것”이라며 “어제 만남 자체가 메시지가 되어 향후 갈등을 완화하는 방향으로 가지 않을까 싶다”고 말했다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “일시적인 갈등 완화에 그치더라도 두 대통령(이재명·문재인)이 통합의 메시지를 낸 것이 주자들과 당원들에게 작지 않은 메시지가 됐을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Despite Claims of 12 Votes, Only 1 in Reality…NEC Confirms 3 More Cases of ‘Incorrect Vote Entry’ (12표 받았다더니 실제론 1표…선관위 ‘득표수 오기입’ 3건 더 확인)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) has discovered three additional instances of incorrect vote tally entries during the June 3 local elections. In the elections for council members in Siheung, Gyeonggi, and Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang, valid and invalid votes were swapped. In the proportional representation election for the Gyeonggi Provincial Council, a party that actually received only one vote at one polling station was entered as receiving 12 votes, sparking a series of erroneous entries. <<> According to data submitted by the NEC on the 2nd to Rep. Choi Bo-yoon of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the June 3 Local Election Ballot Shortage, a full investigation of the vote tally system input revealed three additional cases of incorrect entries. <<> At the third polling station in Shinheun-dong, Siheung’s multi-member district, invalid and valid votes were swapped during a recount. Candidate Ahn Don of the People Power Party was initially recorded as receiving 91 votes but actually received 92 votes. One valid vote for Ahn had been mistakenly entered as invalid. At the second polling station in Yeonseong-dong, candidate Kim Jin-young of the Democratic Party of Korea was recorded as receiving 528 votes but actually received 529 votes. <<> At the Daegok-dong polling station in Gimcheon’s first district, independent candidate Lee Bok-sang was recorded as receiving 812 votes, and independent candidate Park Geon-woo as 767 votes. However, the full investigation showed they received 811 and 766 votes, respectively—one vote fewer each. Two invalid votes had been entered as valid. <<> In the proportional representation election for Gyeonggi Provincial Council, party vote counts were incorrectly entered at multiple stations in Suwon and Ansan’s Danwon-gu, etc. At the fourth polling station in Uman 1-dong, Paldal-gu, Suwon, the New Future Democratic Party, entered as having 12 votes, actually received 1 vote. Liberty and Innovation, entered as 7 votes, had 12 votes, and the Justice Party, entered as 2 votes, actually received 7 votes. <<> At the third polling station in Wa-dong, Danwon-gu, Ansan, the National Alliance, entered as receiving 3 votes, actually got 0 votes. The Christian Party, entered as 0 votes, had 3 votes; the New Future Democratic Party, entered as 11 votes, actually got 3 votes; Liberty and Innovation, entered as 6 votes, had 11 votes; and the Justice Party, entered as receiving 0 votes, actually received 6 votes. <<> The NEC explained, “With many party entry fields, there was confusion, such as shifting entry fields for some parties’ vote counts, leading to the incorrect entries,” adding, “The system will be corrected once appeals for the affected elections are concluded.” <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거에서 개표 결과를 잘못 입력한 사례를 3건 더 발견한 것으로 확인됐다. 경기 시흥시의원과 경북 김천시의원 선거에서는 유효표와 무효표가 뒤바뀌었고, 경기도의회 비례대표 의원 선거에선 한 투표소에서 실제 1표밖에 얻지 못한 정당이 12표를 얻었다고 입력되는 등 ‘무더기 오기입’ 사태가 벌어졌다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Concerns over Side Effects of Complete Abolition of Complementary Investigation Authority Voiced in Democratic Party Lawmakers' Chat Room ([단독] 민주 의원 대화방서 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지 부작용’ 우려 목소리)
item.description:
It has been confirmed that, in a group social media chat room for Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers, some lawmakers expressed concerns about the potential side effects of completely abolishing the prosecution's complementary investigation authority, calling for careful deliberation. It was also reported that arguments were made to retain the authority in exceptional circumstances. (더불어민주당 의원들의 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 단체 대화방에서 일부 의원들이 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전 폐지할 경우에 따른 부작용을 우려하며 숙의가 필요하다는 의견을 낸 것으로 것으로 확인됐다. 예외적 상황에서는 보완수사권을 남겨두자는 주장도 나왔다고 한다.)

According to multiple Democratic Party lawmakers on the 2nd, 4 to 5 lawmakers recently voiced concerns about the complete abolition of the complementary investigation authority in the group chat. One first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area stated, "I propose we look forward to discussion," and suggested, "Conditionally recognize the complementary investigation authority only for cases where the police have filed charges with an opinion to indict, and for other cases, only recognize the request for supplementary investigation, but even that should not be granted if it amounts to a separate investigation." He added, "The purpose of exceptionally allowing the prosecution's complementary investigation is to check the police's excessive investigations and to supplement rushed, poor investigations." (2일 여러 명의 민주당 의원에 따르면 최근 민주당 의원들 단체 대화방에서 의원 4∼5명이 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 우려하는 의견을 밝혔다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 “논의를 기대하는 제안을 한다”며 “경찰이 ‘기소의견 송치’한 사건에 한해 조건부로 보완수사권을 인정하고, 그 외는 보완수사요구권만 인정하되 별건 수사에 해당하는 경우는 보완수사요구권도 주지 말아야 한다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “검찰의 보완수사를 예외적으로 허용하는 건 경찰의 무리한 수사를 견제하고 시간에 쫓긴 부실 수사를 보완하자는 취지”라고 덧붙였다.)

In response, a multi-term lawmaker with a legal background added, "We need to discuss what to do when evidence is being destroyed, or there is a high risk of evidence destruction, or when the statute of limitations is about to expire, or when there is a serious human rights violation by the police in charge of the investigation (if complementary investigation is abolished)." (이에 법조계 출신 다선 의원은 “증거인멸이 진행되고 있거나 증거인멸의 위험성이 높은 상황이나 공소시효 만료가 임박한 경우, 수사를 담당한 경찰의 중대한 인권침해가 있는 경우 (보완수사를 폐지했을 때) 어떻게 할 것인지 논의를 해봐야 한다”는 의견을 더했다.)

A second-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area, who reportedly argued that deliberation on the complementary investigation authority is necessary, expressed concern in a phone call with The Hankyoreh on the same day, saying, "If we completely abolish the complementary investigation authority, it will be difficult to fully prevent harm to the people, no matter what compensatory measures we prepare," and adding, "It seems that candidates for party leader or supreme council members in the party convention are increasingly leaning towards completely abolishing the complementary investigation authority, mindful of the votes of hard-line party members." (보완수사권에 대한 숙의가 필요하다는 의견을 냈다는 수도권 재선 의원은 이날 한겨레와의 통화에서 “보완수사권을 완전 폐지하면 어떤 보완책을 마련하더라도 국민의 피해를 완전히 막기 어렵다”라며 “전당대회 당대표나 최고위원 후보들이 강성 당원들의 표심을 의식해서 보완수사권 완전 폐지 쪽으로 자꾸 방향을 잡아가는 것으로 보인다”고 우려했다.)

On the other hand, a second-term lawmaker with a legal background reportedly stated, "Even if the complementary investigation authority is partially retained, I hope proponents of its retention can prove that it will not be abused." However, it was reported that most lawmakers in the chat did not express their opinions at that time. (반면, 법조계 출신 재선 의원은 “보완수사권을 일부 남겨둘 경우에도 악용되지 않는다는 점을 존치론자들이 입증하면 좋겠다”는 입장을 밝혔다고 한다. 다만 당시 단체방에서 의원 대부분은 의견을 밝히지 않은 것으로 전해졌다.)

Ahead of the party convention in August, voices calling for the "complete abolition of the complementary investigation authority" are growing stronger within the Democratic Party, centered around party leadership contenders. Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party, said at a policy coordination meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "We will launch a task force (TF) for revising the Criminal Procedure Act, centered around the floor leadership, the Policy Committee, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, to begin practical discussions," and added, "We will swiftly devise measures to flawlessly complete the era's task of completely separating investigative authority and prosecutorial authority, and abolishing the complementary investigation authority." (오는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 민주당 내부에선 당권 주자들을 중심으로 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 목소리가 거세지고 있다. 한병도 민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 정책조정회의에서 “원내지도부와 정책위원회, 법제사법위원회를 중심으로 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)를 출범시켜 실무 논의를 시작하겠다”며 “수사권과 기소권의 완전한 분리, 보완수사권 폐지라는 시대적 과제를 빈틈없이 완수할 방안을 신속히 강구하겠다”고 말했다.)

Later that afternoon, Deputy Floor Leader for Policy Kim Han-gyu, Deputy Chair of the Social Division of the Policy Committee Park Sang-hyuk, and Judiciary Committee Secretary Kim Seung-won met to hold the first meeting to establish an internal discussion body within the party. Kim said, "We plan to swiftly compile the specific details of the bill by synthesizing already submitted bills and matters previously discussed within the party." (이날 오후 김한규 원내정책수석부대표와 박상혁 정책위 사회수석부의장, 김승원 법사위 간사가 만나 당내 논의기구를 만들기 위한 1차 회의를 진행했다. 김 수석은 “이미 발의된 법안들과 기존에 당내에서 논의했던 사항들을 종합하여 신속하게 법안의 구체적인 내용을 정리해 나갈 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee Says "Balanced Development and Advanced Industry Hubs Must Align... Not Achieved Through Pressure" (이 대통령 “균형발전·첨단 거점 일치 기회…압력으로 유치 못해”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd that he would "mobilize all available means to support" companies' investments in advanced industries in the Chungcheong region. He directly refuted opposition claims regarding the "Three Major Mega Projects," such as "regional discrimination" and "government-led management," asserting that "we must not approach this divisively." (이재명 대통령이 2일 기업들의 충청권 첨단산업 투자를 “가용한 모든 수단을 동원해 지원하겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’에 관한 야당 등의 ‘지역 차별’, ‘관치’ 주장에는 “분열적으로 접근하면 안 된다”고 정면 반박했다.)

At the "National Report on the Development Vision for Advanced Industries in the Chungcheong Region" held in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, President Lee remarked on the announcement by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Celltrion of a total of 392 trillion won in investments in advanced industries in the region: "We will never miss this critical opportunity to align the hub of balanced development with the hub of advanced industries into one." He added, "The government will actively support these decisions by mobilizing all available means so that the bold moves of companies can shine." This national report came three days after a similar event in Gwangju on the 30th of last month regarding the creation of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region. <<> At the report session, Samsung Display President Lee Cheong, SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung, and Celltrion Pharmaceutical President Yoo Young-ho announced investment plans totaling 392 trillion won, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) fabs, advanced packaging fabs, and biopharmaceutical production facilities. Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jung-kwan signed a "Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for Investment to Foster Advanced Industries in the Chungcheong Region" alongside company representatives. <<> Before the event, President Lee toured exhibits of artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductors and innovative displays with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung at the Samsung Display Asan Campus 2 in Asan, South Chungcheong Province. When Chairman Lee commented, "Due to the AI boom, demand has suddenly surged. We ran out of land at the Busan plant, and now even the land at our old Jochiwon and current Sejong plants is full. Samsung Electro-Mechanics is even asking the Sejong mayor for more land," President Lee replied, "So land is the issue. There's plenty down south," referring to the abundance of sites in the southwestern region. <<> President Lee also strongly criticized the "regional discrimination" and "government-led controversy" during the report session. "It's the role of the government and politics to align interests so that companies think, 'Investing in this region is better,'" he said. "We must not take an approach of complaining, 'Why aren't you doing it for us?' without making any such effort, and get angry." He added, "In today's world, where do companies relocate because of pressure? I've heard outdated ideas suggesting that I pressured Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong into making such a decision. Is that how investment attraction works? It's impossible. Thinking that we can force such investments through pressure or coercion, as in the era of government-led administration, is itself outdated." President Lee also emphasized at a senior secretary meeting held later that afternoon: "Through the Three Major Mega Projects, we will turn the entire country into a Korean version of Silicon Valley. This is not a handout to the regions but the only way for South Korea to become the ultimate winner of the Fourth Industrial Revolution." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 충남 아산시에서 열린 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’에서 삼성과 에스케이(SK)하이닉스, 셀트리온 등이 충청권에 총 392조원의 첨단산업 투자를 발표한 것에 대해 “균형 발전의 거점과 첨단산업 거점을 하나로 일치시킬 이 중대한 기회를 결코 놓치지 않을 것”이라며 “정부는 기업들의 결단이 빛을 발할 수 있도록 가용한 모든 수단을 동원해 적극적으로 지원하겠다”고 말했다. 이날 국민보고회는 지난달 30일 광주에서 열린 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 관련 국민보고회 뒤 사흘 만에 열렸다.)

item.title: Democratic Party forms task force on abolishing supplementary investigation powers… cautious voices within party (민주, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ TF 구성…당내선 신중론도)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 2nd that it will form an internal task force (TF) to discuss amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act, including whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. Amid this, there are also voices calling for carefully preparing measures to address side effects from the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers, or for maintaining them in a limited manner. <<> Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do said at a parliamentary policy coordination meeting that day, "We will launch a Criminal Procedure Act amendment task force centered on the floor leadership, the policy committee, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to begin practical discussions." The previous day, Floor Leader Han stated, "We will quickly finalize the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which is the last piece of prosecutorial reform." Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo also said, "We plan to present the committee's own bills next week and refer them to subcommittees," adding, "The Criminal Procedure Act is also included." <<> Meanwhile, cautious opinions emerged within the party. <<> Lawmaker Kim Young-jin, an original pro-Lee Jae-myung figure, said on MBC Radio that day, "There are aspects related to amending the Criminal Procedure Act and organizing various enforcement ordinances and guidelines accordingly," adding, "It is not appropriate to set a deadline too hastily and proceed that way." The previous day, former President Moon Jae-in, during a Blue House luncheon with President Lee Jae-myung, said regarding prosecutorial reform, "Speed is important, but I ask the government to push forward more carefully and thoroughly so that there are no damages or side effects for the people." <<> Additionally, it was confirmed that in the Democratic Party lawmakers' group chat, about four to five lawmakers recently expressed concerns about the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers. A first-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "We should conditionally recognize supplementary investigation powers only for cases where the police have sent the case with a recommendation for indictment, and for other cases, only recognize the right to request supplementary investigation—but if it involves a separate investigation, even that should not be granted," adding, "The intent is to check excessive police investigations and supplement insufficient investigations rushed by time constraints." A multi-term lawmaker with a legal background also told The Hankyoreh, "We need to discuss what to do in situations with high risk of evidence destruction, or when the statute of limitations is near expiration, or when there has been a serious human rights violation by the investigating police (if supplementary investigations are abolished)." <<> Reporters Jeong Hye-min and Kim Chae-woon jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 2일 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부 등 형사소송법 개정안을 논의할 당내 태스크포스(TF)를 구성하겠다고 밝혔다. 이런 가운데, 보완수사권 완전 폐지로 인한 부작용 대책을 신중히 마련하거나 제한적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 목소리도 나오고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Utilize Additional Tax Revenue to Create Investment Resources for Future Generations" (이 대통령 “추가 세수 활용해 미래 세대 투자 재원 조성”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung expressed on the 2nd his intention to invest the surplus tax revenue expected from the semiconductor boom into youth policies. (이재명 대통령이 2일 반도체 호황으로 예상되는 초과 세수를 청년 정책에 투자하겠다는 뜻을 표시했다.)

During a senior secretary meeting held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee stated, "I hope you will make every effort to efficiently utilize the anticipated additional tax revenue to establish stable investment resources for future generations." He outlined plans to use the surplus tax revenue, projected to exceed 40 trillion won this year due to the semiconductor export boom, to support the younger generation. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “최근에 예상되고 있는 추가 세수를 효율적으로 활용해 미래 세대를 위한 안정적인 투자 재원을 조성하는 데도 만전을 기해주길 바란다”고 말했다. 반도체 수출 호황에 따라 올해 40조원 규모를 웃돌 것으로 전망되는 초과 세수를 청년 세대 지원에 쓰겠다는 구상을 밝힌 것이다.)

President Lee had also mentioned the government's startup support project, the "Everyone's Startup" initiative, at a Cabinet meeting on March 23, saying, "Among considerations on how to use the additional tax revenue, improving the startup environment to secure growth potential is a major part," indicating his commitment to strengthening support for the youth. (이 대통령은 지난달 23일 청와대 국무회의에서도 정부 창업 지원 사업인 ‘모두의 창업’ 프로젝트를 언급하면서 “추가 세수를 어떻게 활용할지에 대한 고민 중에 성장 잠재력 확보를 위해 창업 환경을 개선하는 것도 큰 부분”이라고 말하며 청년층 지원 강화 의지를 표시했다.)

Regarding the "Culture and Arts Pass," which subsidizes costs for performances, exhibitions, and movies, President Lee proposed, "If this policy shows high satisfaction and tangible benefits for young people, consider planning ways to expand it or apply it to other policies," according to Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong. Explaining the "Three Mega Projects for Korea's Great Leap Forward," President Lee emphasized, "This path will take responsibility for Korea's next 30 years and open a larger window of opportunity for all youth across the nation. I urge the public, businesses, the government, and the political sphere to unite their efforts. We must do our utmost to build an asset ladder for everyone, including the youth." (이 대통령은 또 공연·전시·영화 관람비를 지원하는 ‘문화예술패스’에 대해서도 “(청년들의) 만족도와 체감도가 높은 정책이라면 확장 방안 및 다른 정책으로 응용해 적용할 수 있는 방안도 기획해보라”고 제안했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 전했다. 이 대통령은 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트’를 설명하며 “대한민국의 미래 30년을 책임지고, 전국의 모든 청년에게 더 큰 기회의 창을 열어줄 이 길에 국민과 기업, 정부, 정치권 모두 하나 된 힘을 모아달라. 청년을 포함한 모두의 자산 사다리 구축에 최선을 다해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

President Lee's recent repeated emphasis on strengthening youth policies is not unrelated to low approval ratings among the 2030 generation. According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) released on the same day by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research, positive evaluations among those in their 20s stood at 45% (negative evaluations 39%), lower than the average positive evaluation of 58% (negative evaluations 35%) across other age groups. (For details, refer to the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee.) (이 대통령이 최근 청년 정책 강화를 연이어 강조하는 것은 2030세대의 낮은 국정 지지도와 무관하지 않다. 이날 발표된 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치의 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과를 보면, 20대의 경우 긍정 평가가 45%(부정 평가 39%)로 다른 연령대의 평균 긍정 평가 58%(부정 평가 35%)보다 낮았다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-shik also announced on April 1 the establishment of a "Cheong Wa Dae Fellowship," allowing young people to directly evaluate national decision-making processes. (강훈식 대통령비서실장 역시 지난 1일 청년들이 국정 의사 결정을 직접 평가할 수 있는 ‘청와대 펠로십’을 신설하겠다고 말한 바 있다.)

Reporter Goh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Specialization or Jointness? Military Academy Integration Sparks Heated Debate (전문성이냐 합동성이냐…사관학교 통합 ‘뜨거운 감자’)
item.description:
The debate over merging the Army, Navy, and Air Force military academies into a single institution is intensifying. Proponents emphasize jointness, while opponents stress the importance of specialization. (육·해·공군 사관학교를 하나로 합치는 사관학교 통합을 두고 찬반 논란이 뜨겁다. 찬성하는 쪽은 합동성을, 반대하는 쪽은 전문성을 강조한다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-back stated at the All-Forces Key Commanders Meeting on the 1st, “The specialization of each service branch must be preserved. However, this specialization should not become a ‘silo,’ and jointness must be integrated into the military’s culture.” Strengthening jointness means that the Army, Navy, and Air Force should move beyond service-centric interests and develop the ability to conduct integrated operations across air, sea, and land. Minister Ahn emphasized, “Jointness must be instilled as a core trait through shared learning, training, and thinking from the military academy stage, which can then be refined and evolved in the field.” <<> The integration of military academies was a campaign pledge of President Lee Jae-myung and is now a national agenda item. In a speech on February 20 at the Gyeryongdae joint commissioning ceremony for graduates of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, President Lee stated, “We will integrate the three service academies to systematically cultivate defense talent capable of leading future battlefields.” <<> In contrast, the Korea Military Academy (KMA) Alumni Association and others argue that the fundamental role of a military academy is to enhance specialization. A KMA Alumni Association official said, “The Army, Navy, and Air Force academies are institutions for understanding the unique characteristics of each service and establishing their identity.” Some KMA graduates claim the integration is political retaliation aimed at shutting down the academy by labeling it a “hotbed of the December 3 insurrection.” <<> As the issue of military academy integration has devolved into a debate over the “closure of KMA,” discussions on finding practical improvements for current academy education have disappeared. <<> It seems clear that the current military academies have limitations in nurturing cadets who are suited for the era of convergence and possess a strong democratic civic consciousness through broad and diverse education. A particular problem is that the faculty is predominantly composed of active-duty officers who are alumni of their respective academies. As of 2024, civilian professors make up only 12.8% at KMA, 14.5% at the Naval Academy, and 11% at the Air Force Academy. In contrast, the proportion of civilian professors at U.S. service academies ranges from 30% to 50%. <<> Compared to general universities, each of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies has a small student body, limiting their ability to provide diverse and in-depth education. Annual admissions quotas are around 300 for KMA, 170 for the Naval Academy, and 200 for the Air Force Academy. <<> In recent years, competition rates and academic scores for military academies have plummeted, largely due to the institutions’ declining competitiveness as educational establishments. Cadets study for four years in a state isolated from society and then serve in the military until their 40s or 50s. In extreme cases, this can lead to prioritizing personal connections over public values, as seen with active-duty and retired generals from KMA during the December 3 insurrection. <<> The core of the recommendations submitted in January by the Ministry of National Defense’s “Civil-Military-Government Joint Special Advisory Committee, Military Academy Education Reform Subcommittee” was to establish a “National Defense University of Korea.” Under this plan, the existing Army, Navy, and Air Force academies would become constituent colleges within the university. Cadets would receive foundational knowledge and basic major education in their first and second years, then proceed to advanced major courses and military training at their respective service academies in their third and fourth years. <<> The Ministry of National Defense plans to finalize the bill for establishing the National Defense University within this year. If so, it would implement admissions procedures next year, with integrated selection considered starting in the 2028 academic year. This would currently apply to students in their sophomore year of high school. However, the Higher Education Act stipulates that universities must announce their admission implementation plans at least one year and ten months before the start of the admission year. The plan for the 2028 academic year should have been announced last May. This inevitably creates confusion for prospective military academy applicants. <<> Kwon Hyuk-chul Reporter nura@hani.co.kr ( 안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 1일 전군주요지휘관회의에서 “각 군의 전문성은 반드시 지켜져야 한다. 그러나 그 전문성이 ‘칸막이’가 되어서는 안 되고, 합동성을 체질화해야 한다”고 말했다. 합동성 강화는 육·해·공군이 자군 이기주의에 빠지지 않고 하늘과 바다, 육지에서 함께 유기적으로 작전을 수행할 수 있는 능력을 키워야 한다는 뜻이다. 안 장관은 “합동성은 사관학교에서부터 함께 배우고 훈련하고 생각하는 과정을 통해 체질화시킨 후에 야전에서 더 다듬고 진화시켜 나가야 한다”고 강조했다.)
